description:
Lot of 5 Vintage Glass Electrical Insulators Hemingray Blue Green Clear
This lot includes 5 vintage glass electrical insulators featuring both aqua/blue-green and clear glass varieties. Two blue-green insulators are marked with 'HEMINGRAY' and 'MADE IN U.S.A.'. Each insulator is made of heavy, thick glass with a classic double-groove design. Most pieces exhibit signs of age including minor dirt, residue, and surface wear but have no major cracks or chips visible. The clear glass insulators include one with a partial label and some with embossed markings. These insulators were originally used on telegraph and power lines and are suitable for collectors or as decorative industrial items.

description:
Vintage Glass Insulators Lot - 7 Pieces
Hemingray, Whitall Tatum Co., Made in USA
Clear and Aqua Glass, Early to Mid-20th Century
Collection of seven vintage glass telegraph and telephone insulators, featuring examples from prominent American manufacturers including Hemingray and Whitall Tatum. These utilitarian objects were essential components of the nation's early telecommunications infrastructure, and today they are highly collectible for their industrial aesthetic and varying glass tones.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray - 9 insulator, light aqua glass, embossed mark on base
Whitall Tatum Co. insulator, clear glass, embossed base mark
Made in USA insulator, clear glass, marked 21-52
Made in USA insulator, clear glass, marked 28
Three (3) additional Made in USA insulators, clear glass, various sizes
Condition:
Overall very good vintage condition. Most pieces show typical base roughness and small fleabites consistent with industrial use and age. No significant structural cracks. The glass remains largely clear with some minor surface soot or mineral deposits from outdoor exposure.

description:
Hemingray Glass Insulators Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray Glass Company, No. 17 and Patent 1893 Models
Aqua Blue and Clear, Vintage 19th to 20th Century
This collection features three vintage glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, once the world's largest manufacturer of glass insulators. These utilitarian pieces were originally designed to support telegraph and telephone wires, and are now highly sought after for their iconic industrial aesthetic and diverse color variations.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua Blue glass, marked "HEMINGRAY" and "PATENT MAY 2 1893," featuring sharp drip points on the base edge.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Condition:
The aqua blue insulator shows significant internal soot or carbon deposits and surface grime from authentic outdoor service. The clear insulators show minor surface wear and occasional internal bubbles characteristic of molded utility glass. No significant structural cracks are observed, though minor fleabites consistent with industrial usage may be present along the base edges.

description:
Natural Stone Collection
Polished Agate and Amethyst Specimens - Brazil Origin
Vintage Collection, 7 Pieces
This assembly of geological specimens highlights the diverse mineralogy of South American deposits, specifically those of Brazil. Included are three distinct macrocrystalline quartz specimens (agate), each cut and polished to reveal concentric chalcedony banding and translucent crystalline centers. The collection is further enhanced by amethyst in both its raw druzy form and a polished hexagonal point, representing the purple variety of quartz colored by iron impurities. A polished pink stone egg and a small black mineral specimen complete the set.
3 Polished Agate display chunks/bookends in teal, blue, and earth tones
1 Amethyst Druzy cluster with deep purple crystalline surface
1 Polished Amethyst Obelisk point
1 Polished Pink Stone Egg specimen
1 Small Black mineral specimen (Tourmaline style)
Original "Made in Brazil" label present on blue agate specimen

Condition:

Natural inclusions, internal fractures, and minor surface pitting are characteristic of geological specimens and are not considered defects. The amethyst druzy retains sharp, well-defined crystals. description:
Ancient & Historical Artifact Lot
Stone Projectile Points and Clay Pipe Fragments
17 Items, Mixed Age and Origin
This collection features a diverse assortment of lithic artifacts and historical clay pipe components. The stone pieces display varying degrees of bifacial flaking, pressure flaking, and retouching across multiple chert and flint varieties. The inclusion of early clay pipe fragments suggests a broad chronological range, potentially spanning from prehistoric indigenous cultures to historical-era trade goods.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Large Chert Blade
- Light grey chert with significant bifacial thinning and shaped edge.
2.
Projectile Points (14)
- Assorted sizes and styles including side-notched, corner-notched, and stemmed bases in grey, tan, and reddish-brown stone.
3.
Reeded Clay Pipe Bowl
- Terracotta-colored clay with vertical fluting or reeded decorative pattern.
4.
Clay Pipe Stem Fragment
- Smooth, curved section of a clay pipe stem in similar terracotta-toned material.
Materials: Chert, flint, and fired clay
Construction: Knapped stone tools; molded and fired ceramics
Dimensions: Approximately 6" x 4" x 3" lot footprint (provided)
Condition:
Mixed artifact condition. Stone points show expected weathering and varying degrees of edge wear; some tips or bases may show ancient or modern breaks consistent with find-site artifacts. Clay pipe fragments are incomplete sections (bowl and stem). Surface patina and soil staining present throughout consistent with excavated or field-found materials.

description:
Cross
Yellow Gold Filled Pen and Pencil Set
Vintage American Writing Instruments
This vintage Cross writing set features a matching ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil finished in elegant yellow gold fill. A staple of professional gift-giving and executive stationery for decades, Cross instruments are renowned for their slim profiles, signature conical tops, and reliable twist-action mechanisms. This set represents mid-to-late 20th-century office luxury and comes complete with its original presentation case and accessories.
Classic slim-profile design with yellow gold-filled finish and ribbed linear pattern
Set includes both a twist-action ballpoint pen and a matching mechanical pencil
Original presentation box with brown textured exterior and cream satin lining
Includes genuine leather pen purse with gold-tone rose emblem and instructions
Condition:
Good vintage condition overall. The gold-filled finish shows light surface scratching and minor age-appropriate wear to the polished surfaces. The presentation box remains structurally sound, though there is light fraying to the internal brown fabric securing bands. Both the pen and pencil currently require new ink refills or lead cartridges to be operational.

description:
You are purchasing a "Vintage Briar and Corn Cob Tobacco Pipes (3)" in "Used" condition.
Set of three well-worn vintage smoking pipes, perfect for restoration, display, or as characterful decor pieces. Each pipe has its own unique look and texture, giving this trio a lot of visual interest and old-world charm. You’ll receive: - One Dr. Grabow briar pipe with a carved, rustic bowl and curved stem. - One darker rusticated briar pipe with a straight stem and deeply textured bowl. - One classic corn cob style pipe with a straight wooden stem. All three pipes show significant age and use, making them ideal candidates for a cleaning and restoration project or as props and collectibles with authentic patina. Great for collectors, crafters, photographers, or anyone who loves the look of old tobacco pipes. Keywords: vintage pipes, Dr. Grabow pipe, briar pipe lot, corn cob pipe, rustic smoking pipe, pipe restoration, man cave decor, tobacco pipe collection, photo prop
This is a previously owned item being sold AS-IS and have not been tested. Items may have light surface dust/debris and scratches.
Items have varying degrees of wear and residue and may be missing parts.  Expect signs of wear consistent with age.
Condition Notes:
All three pipes show heavy use and age wear. The reddish briar pipe has a rough, carved bowl surface with darkening and buildup inside the bowl, worn finish on the shank, and scuffs and scratches on the curved stem. The darker rusticated briar pipe has a heavily worn, textured bowl with darkening, surface grime along the shank, and a discolored stem with visible wear and small marks. The corn cob style pipe has a yellowed, worn cob bowl with chipping and surface residue, along with a straight wooden stem showing discoloration, small spots, and handling wear. Overall surfaces show scratches, discoloration, and buildup consistent with frequent use and age.

When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

title: Antique Trilobite Fossil Natural Stone Matrix 6.5" Marine Arthropod Paleozoic
description:
Natural Trilobite Fossil
Stone Matrix Specimen
Paleozoic Era
This impressive trilobite fossil is preserved within its natural stone matrix, displaying the characteristic segmented exoskeleton of these ancient marine arthropods. The specimen features a well-defined thoracic region and cephalon, highlighted by a hand-tooled border prepared in the surrounding sedimentary stone to emphasize the fossil's biological form. As a representative of the Paleozoic Era, this piece offers a tangible connection to Earth's prehistoric oceans and early biological diversity.
Natural fossil specimen embedded in sedimentary stone matrix
Detailed thoracic segments and cephalon structure visible on the dorsal surface
Manually prepared border carved into the matrix to highlight the central specimen
Dimensions: 6.5" L x 6" W x 1" H; Weight: 2.1 lbs
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fossil is structurally sound within the matrix with no visible structural repairs or artificial reconstructions. The stone matrix remains solid with natural mineral variations and ochre-toned oxidation consistent with geological aging. The reverse side exhibits natural stone textures and fossiliferous fragments.
